posting.headline: Head of Talent Acquisition (operators to managers), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo for an AI project. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. We hire operators, site leads, Portfolio Managers, runners, and office roles, and we hire fast. The Head of Talent Acquisition owns the whole pipeline: finding people, screening them, and getting them to a signed first day.
do: Fill every open seat: operators, site leads, Portfolio Managers, runners, hub attendants, and office roles.
Keep a live list of open seats and the days each one has been open. Report it to the Chief of Staff every week.
Find candidates where they are: the sites, referrals from our people, job boards, and the neighbourhoods around each site.
Run the onboarding screening with the Portfolio Managers: ID copy, age 18 or older, consent, the fraud briefing, one account per person.
Keep the operator bench at 10% of every book, so a site never waits for a person.
Write the offer letters from the templates and get every first day signed.
Run the referral programme and pay out the referral rewards through finance.
need: You have recruited field staff in volume in Egypt: factory, delivery, security, or retail.
You can fill ten seats in a week without lowering the bar.
Careful with papers. No ID copy, no consent, no start.
Straight with candidates about the job, the pay, and the rules.
plus: You have run a referral programme.
You have hired managers as well as workers.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
A referral reward for every hire that stays.
Every role written down: a posting, a handbook, and an offer letter, ready to use.
A recruiter under you once open seats pass twenty in a month.
posting.apply: Send your name, where you live, a phone number, and the teams you have hired. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Head of Talent Acquisition at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the Chief of Staff.
Your start date is {start}. In your first weeks you take over the open seats from {manager}, meet every Portfolio Manager, and run your first onboarding screening.

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
expect: Every open seat has a name in the pipeline within a week.
Nobody starts without complete papers, whoever referred them.
The bench of every book stays at 10%.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours, and every hour needs a person on the floor with complete papers. Sites open, people leave, and books grow. You keep every seat filled and every bench at 10%, without ever lowering the bar on the papers. Mano owns people. You own the pipeline.
outcomes: Every open seat has a candidate in the pipeline within a week, and a person in it within the target.
Nobody starts without the onboarding screening complete.
Every book has a bench of 10%.
Mano knows the open seats and the days to fill every week.
daily: Morning. The open seats list. Which ones are new, which are late, which have a first day this week.
All day. Calls, visits, and screenings. Candidates are found where they are, not from a desk.
Same day. A Portfolio Manager with an empty seat hears from you today, with a name or a date.
Before a first day. Every paper in the file: ID copy, consent, fraud briefing, account created.
weekly: Once a week. The open seats and the days to fill, to Mano.
Once a week. The bench of every book with Moharam. Under 10% means hiring now.
Once a week. Referrals: who referred whom, who started, who is due a reward.
monthly: Month end. Hires that stayed the month, hires that left, and why.
Month end. Referral rewards to Ahmed Alaa for payment.
standards: No ID copy, no consent, no start. Whoever referred them.
One account per person, in their own name, created before the first day.
Nobody under 18. Nobody removed for fraud comes back, under any name.
The job, the pay, and the rules are said plainly before anyone signs.
To anyone outside the company, the work is an AI project. Nothing more.
never: A first day without complete papers.
A removed worker hired again under another name.
A promise to a candidate that the handbook does not make.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: With Mano. Every open seat, every template, and the referral programme.
Meet every Portfolio Manager. Run one onboarding screening yourself.
Fill five seats. Send Mano your first weekly report.
Every book at a 10% bench, or a date for it. Mano signs you off.

measures: Days from a seat opening to a signed first day.
Hires with complete papers before day one. All of them.
handbook.call: Mano for anything you cannot settle, and for the papers. Moharam for the bench and where people are needed. The Portfolio Managers for their seats and their screenings. Ahmed Alaa for referral rewards. The Head of Legal for a contract question.
